title: Dizon: 3 DPWH-Davao officials sacked amid flood control probe

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Three officials of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) in Davao City were removed from their posts amid the investigation of the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) into alleged anomalies of flood control projects in the city, according to Secretary Vince Dizon on Monday. Dizon said that the following officials are relieved immediately as the investigation is ongoing: Former District Engineer Richard Ragasa (currently assigned as Assistant Regional Director of DPWH Region 4-B); Assistant District Engineer Lilibeth Sarmiento; and Construction Chief Roberto Mamaril.
